description: FinChiefs' Investment Themes board: the durable themes research houses argue, each an opportunity or a risk, with one vote per house (for / against / mixed), agreement, change in houses, the newest views, tactical vs longer-term tallies, flags (where houses agree, contrarian minorities), what could go wrong (risk themes), positioning in the related futures market, related themes moving the same market the other way, and the By asset view (houses up vs down per asset class). Start here for "what are houses arguing", consensus or crowded trades, risks, and the year-ahead outlook (horizon: "longer_term"). Call get_theme for one theme's houses and named instruments.

by_asset.description: Include the By asset groups (default true).

horizon.description: "longer_term" (cyclical and strategic views; the year-ahead outlook) or "tactical" keep themes with 3+ houses on that horizon and rank by that tally. Default "all".

kind.description: Only opportunities or only risks. Omit for both.

lens.description: agree: opportunities 70%+ of houses back (6+ houses). contrarian: a 70%+ majority with at least one house on the other side. rising_contrarian: that minority grew over the last week.

limit.description: Themes to return, most houses first. Default 30.

slugs.description: Specific theme slugs (from an earlier result or a related list).

terms.description: Whole-word match on theme title, thesis, moves (asset or market), exposure keys and named instruments, e.g. ["gold"], ["japan", "nikkei"], ["semiconductors", "SMH"].

name: get_investment_themes
title: Get the Investment Themes board
